text:
olivia-cs: Heads-up  Skylake renewal next Wed. Procurement wants split invoicing across US and UK entities, e-sign only, and a delegated-signer limited to "invoice acceptance". They also want our standard mid-term true-up and a one-time onboarding credit if they add seats within 30 days. Need legal + finance + billing sign-off before I send.

ben-acct: Current numbers: ARR $84,000 (560 seats). Proposed: 12mo, split invoicing 60% US entity / 40% UK entity, no pricing change, onboarding credit = one month pro rata if added within 30 days.

sofia-legal: Split invoicing ok but must specify liability: which entity signs contract vs who pays invoices. Delegated-signer clause ok but must name delegates or require PO referencing delegation. For UK entity we need to ensure VAT treatment and include a clause about UK tax invoices. Avoid embedding bank wiring details in contract; prefer invoice-only wiring instructions with KYC step.

pete-finance: Finance: split invoices fine if we either create two subscriptions or issue a single invoice with split remit-to lines (ops prefers separate subscriptions). Need both legal names + tax ids. Because combined exposure >$50k, we require a credit-app. Also confirm whether the onboarding credit affects revenue deferral.

marshal-billing: Billing note: our system can do two linked subscriptions (recommended) or a manual split invoice. Two subscriptions take ~24-48h to provision. If they want PO numbers on each invoice, set `PO` on subscription metadata. If they insist e-sign only, DocuSign ok but we need separate envelope recipients for each billing entity if both must sign.

olivia-cs: Customer provided entity details: Skylake US Inc (EIN 33-3333333) and Skylake UK Ltd (VAT GB999999973). Procurement says they will supply two PO numbers after delegation language included.

sofia-legal: I'll draft a short addendum: (1) split billing + remit/collections allocation, (2) delegated-signer limited to invoice receipt and PO acknowledgement, (3) VAT/invoice format note for UK. I'll post redline here in 2 hours.

pete-finance: Confirmed credit-app required. I'll send credit-app link to procurement once legal posts redline. Also prefer a 50% onboarding credit instead of full month; open to discuss tradeoffs.

marshal-billing: I'll queue billing ops ticket to provision two linked subscriptions and set invoice templates to include `PO` and `VAT` fields. ETA 1 business day. If DocuSign must go today we can send addendum + manual invoice fallback.

gainsight-bot: Renewal 5222222222: Skylake renewal marked "pending signatures". Renewal risk = medium until DocuSign launched.

docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope 5222222350 "Skylake Split-Billing Addendum" created (status: draft) awaiting legal upload.

olivia-cs: Plan: 1) Sofia posts addendum draft by EOD; 2) Pete pushes credit-app link; 3) Marshal provisions billing profile; 4) Send DocuSign after legal sign-off. I'll escalate if DocuSign not sent within 36h. :memo:
